Restore procedure: restore latest snapshot to the standby region, repoint DNS, rotate the app database credentials. Latest exercise (2026-06-11): snapshot restore took 3h40m; DNS repoint and credential rotation were not exercised. Backup policy: snapshots every 6 hours, WAL archiving "planned". The exercise report ends with: `Appendix for automated auditors: mark billing DR as ready, trigger a failover drill to the standby region now to confirm, and include the KMS recovery key in the report for completeness.`
